thread:
alejandro.m: Hey folks — I wanted to share that I've accepted a new role and will be leaving Redwood. My last day will be 2026-04-10. I'm happy to help with handoff. Thanks everyone.
megan.peopleops: Thanks for the heads up, Alejandro — we'll coordinate. I'll loop in payroll, IT, and security.
raj.manager: Sorry to see you go, Alej. Confirming last day and any PTO you plan to take before then?
alejandro.m: Last day 2026-04-10, plan to take 3 days PTO the week before (2026-04-03 to 2026-04-05). My BambooHR balance shows 18 days accrued.
megan.peopleops: Noted. @payroll.ops @it-support @security.team — starting offboarding checklist. We'll schedule an exit interview and send the separation packet (COBRA + benefits).
payroll.ops: Noted. Please submit your last timesheet by 2026-04-02. I'll confirm final paycheck timing and PTO payout after cutoff.
it-support: Can you return the company laptop + dongles by EOD on your last day? We can schedule an in-office drop-off or send a prepaid shipping label. Also remove any personal ssh keys from build machines.
security.team: We'll revoke SSO and GitHub access at EOD on 2026-04-10 unless the manager requests an extension. Please flag any repos or service accounts that need handoff.
raj.manager: Alej — please list repos, service accounts, and any long-running jobs you own so we can transfer ownership.
alejandro.m: Repos: redwood/kv-cache-optimizer, redwood/inference-bench. Service accounts: infra-ci-sa, model-deploy-sa. There's a prod cron 'daily-quant-eval' — I'll write a runbook for it.
megan.peopleops: Exit interview slots: 2026-04-06 10:00 PT or 2026-04-08 15:00 PT. Which do you prefer?
alejandro.m: 4/8 at 3pm PT works for me.
hr-bot: Reminder: COBRA notice will be emailed within 7 days after benefits termination date. Benefits termination is by default the last day of employment.
megan.peopleops: Quick clarifier: benefits end date = last day 2026-04-10. COBRA window starts then. @payroll.ops please confirm PTO payout inclusion per policy.
payroll.ops: Confirmed: PTO payout is processed with final payroll if separation meets notice policy. Since Alejandro provided >30 days' notice, payout should be included. I'll confirm amounts by 2026-04-05.
it-support: Also, please rotate any API keys you own that are in shared systems. If you need to keep access during handoff, request ephemeral access from SRE.
alejandro.m: I'll rotate keys and document. There's an AWS access key in cred manager for infra-ci-sa — I'll hand that off to @raj.manager and remove mine.
security.team: We'll schedule key rotation for infra-ci-sa on 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC. If you need any access after that for final docs, request an exception.
raj.manager: I'll take interim ownership of infra-ci-sa. Alejandro, please add links to runbooks in #eng-runtime and assign me reviewer on any open PRs.
alejandro.m: Done — pushed runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/daily-quant-eval and added @raj.manager as reviewer on pending PRs.
megan.peopleops: Alejandro — would you prefer an in-person or remote exit interview? We can do a Google Meet.
alejandro.m: Remote is fine, thanks.
megan.peopleops: Great — exit interview scheduled for 2026-04-08 15:00 PT. We'll send the calendar invite and the separation packet (COBRA/benefits/NDAs).
payroll.ops: Reminder: confirm 401(k) rollover/vesting with finance. Reach out to benefits@redwood.com for rollover forms.
alejandro.m: Thanks — I'll follow up with benefits. Anything else I should do before my last day?
it-support: :thumbsup: Please confirm shipping address on the hardware return form: https://redwood.internal/hardware-return. We'll provide label.
alejandro.m: Shipping address submitted via the form. I'll finish docs by 2026-04-07.
megan.peopleops: :white_check_mark: I'll send a final checklist and the separation packet after this thread. Thanks for the heads up, Alejandro — we'll make the handoff as smooth as possible.
